Thanks for the review, I’ll fix those tomorrow!On 29 Aug 2026, at 10:27, undefined-landmark ***@***.***> wrote:﻿
@undefined-landmark commented on this pull request.

Thanks for packaging. I only recently discovered this project. Good to see that there is already a PR for it. Only one small nit from my side. Would be better if the tests can be run but that'd require some upstream changes I'm afraid.

In pkgs/by-name/up/upbrr/package.nix:
> +  postInstall = ''
+    wrapProgram $out/bin/upbrr \
+      --prefix PATH : ${lib.makeBinPath [ ffmpeg ]}
+  '';
+
+  ldflags = [
+    "-s"
+    "-w"
+    "-X main.version=${finalAttrs.version}"
+    "-X main.buildIdentifier="
+  ];
+
+  # One of the tests that is executed checks path redaction from the logs, and
+  # expects TMPDIR to be in /tmp. Since nix sets it inside the nix build
+  # directory, we can not execute the tests without breaking it.
+  doCheck = false;

In qui, the env var TMPDIR is set: https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/413a9b88e4284b6f118f8e565b3442ade07336ae/pkgs/by-name/qu/qui/package.nix#L75 I tried this locally, but there are still some tests failing...



In pkgs/by-name/up/upbrr/package.nix:
> +
+  buildInputs = [ ffmpeg ];
+  nativeBuildInputs = [ makeWrapper ];
+
+  preBuild = ''
+    mkdir -p "internal/webserver/assets"
+    cp -R ${finalAttrs.upbrr-webui}/. "internal/webserver/assets"
+  '';
+
+  postInstall = ''
+    wrapProgram $out/bin/upbrr \
+      --prefix PATH : ${lib.makeBinPath [ ffmpeg ]}
+  '';
+
+  ldflags = [
+    "-s"

The -s and -w flags are not set in qui and autobrr. There has been some discussion on this: #346380. I'm not sure what the latest guideline. I'm sure -w is redundant when -s is set though: https://pkg.go.dev/cmd/link. So either just drop -w or drop both -s and -w.
